newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil struggles for buyers.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil struggles for buyers.

text.p: Russian straight run in NWE and the Med was well offered and having difficulty finding buyers on Wednesday, traders said.
Low sulphur in NWE talked around $145 fob NWE, although some offers were as high as $150 - "unrealistic" said some traders.

A low water NWE M-100 was heard offered at $124 cif NWE with best bid heard at $123. E-4 cargoes were less popular, but prices were firm around $133-135 cif NWE as dealers considered the prospect of material starting to dry up.
In the Med a low sulphur 30kt cargo has arrived in Augusta still without a buyer. It was offered today at $134 cif.
